style: Cinematic 2.5D illustrated concept art for a premium animated technical documentary. Stylized semi-realistic, clean readable shapes, calm and confident mood, soft volumetric light, gentle rim light, subtle film grain, high detail. Palette: warm amber-orange lamplight and honey wood for the connected preparation workshop; deep navy, slate and cool teal-white for the controlled, sealed side; no harsh red. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks, no screens with writing, no user-interface panels, no code, no people's faces in close-up.

images.prompt: Wide shot down a long, calm, spotless high-tech corridor at night that ends in a monumental round sealed vault door, closed, rimmed with a thin cool teal light. The floor is polished and reflective, the walls are smooth slate panels with soft linear light strips. The centre of the corridor is open and uncluttered, leaving empty space in the middle and lower third of the frame. Quiet, controlled, a little tense.

Wide establishing shot of a grand, orderly, warmly lit workshop-library atrium, seen from a slightly elevated position. Three distinct alcoves stand side by side across the back: the left alcove holds tall shelves of neatly bound books and rolled scrolls; the centre alcove holds neat racks of small, identical, closed metal shipping containers stacked like a tidy warehouse; the right alcove holds rows of softly glowing glass data cylinders on shelves. In the foreground centre stands a large round wooden worktable under a warm pendant lamp. Honey wood, brass details, warm amber-orange light, a sense of care and trust.

Medium-wide shot of a long, clean, warm wooden packing workbench in the same warm workshop, seen from the front at table height. The middle of the bench is clear and empty, ready for an object to be placed there. Behind the bench, the back wall has three tall arched passages side by side, each glowing with cool blue-white light from the far side, like three secure routes leading out. Brass lamps, tidy tool racks, warm amber light in front, cool light beyond the arches.

A calm, precise inspection bay: a smooth low plinth in the centre of a dim slate-grey room, with a tall elegant scanning arch above it emitting a thin horizontal sheet of cool teal light. Fine reflections on a dark polished floor. The plinth top is empty. Clinical, quiet, trustworthy, symmetrical composition with generous empty space on the left and right.

Epic wide night view of a long, elegant, straight bridge high above a calm sea of moonlit clouds. Along the bridge stand ten identical slender gate arches in a row, receding into the distance, each faintly lit in cool teal. At the far end of the bridge stands a sealed, windowless, clean white building with no antennas and no cables, glowing softly. Deep navy sky, a few stars, serene and controlled. Wide empty sky in the upper third.

Interior of a sealed, windowless clean-room laboratory, cool white and teal light, smooth curved walls, quiet and isolated. In the centre stands a waist-high workstation plinth with an empty lit top. Along the sides, neat rows of small identical sealed glass pods glow softly, like isolated compartments. No cables leading outside, no windows, no doors visible. Calm, precise, completely self-contained.

Wide cinematic dawn panorama. On the left, a warm-lit workshop building with glowing amber windows on a hillside. A long, graceful bridge crosses a calm misty valley from the workshop to a clean, sealed white laboratory building on the right. Soft golden morning light rising, gentle mist, hopeful and confident, a complete journey seen from a distance. Open sky in the upper part of the frame.

A single sturdy, premium hard-shell equipment case, closed, three-quarter view from slightly above: rounded corners, matte deep navy shell with brushed brass corner guards, two brass latches and a sturdy handle, a subtle thin teal light seam along the lid edge. Isolated object on a fully transparent background, soft contact shadow, no text, no labels, no stickers.

One small, clean, stylized metal shipping container seen in three-quarter view, closed doors, ribbed sides, painted soft steel blue with subtle brass hinges. Isolated object on a fully transparent background, soft contact shadow, no text, no numbers, no markings.

The same case from the reference image, same shell, colours, brass corner guards and latches, now shown open with the lid raised: inside, neat dark foam compartments hold small, softly glowing items — a slim bound book, a few tiny steel-blue shipping containers, small glass data cylinders and a few small brass cartridges — all tidy and secure, lit with a soft teal-white glow from inside. Same three-quarter view. Isolated object on a fully transparent background, no text, no labels.
